resources.string: Shows pause and block screens for the apps you set rules for.

OpenBlock uses this service to notice which app is on screen and to show a pause or block screen for the apps you created rules for. For feed rules in supported apps (such as YouTube Shorts) it checks whether views with known identifiers are visible. It does not read text, messages or passwords, it does not store screen content, and it has no network access. Everything stays on this device. You can turn it off here at any time.
